title: Supplier Compliance Screen input
description: Screen up to three supplier names using public FDA and EPA records.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Company names to search (maximum 3 per run).

state.title: State filter
state.description: Optional US state abbreviation used for the EPA ECHO search.

companyStates.title: Company-specific state filters
companyStates.description: Optional two-letter state list aligned by index with companies; overrides global state.

lookbackYears.title: Lookback years
lookbackYears.description: FDA records older than this many years are omitted. EPA results use EPA's current summary window.

maxMatchesPerCompany.title: Maximum FDA matches per company
maxMatchesPerCompany.description: Maximum FDA records across food, drug, and device enforcement endpoints.
